ex.en: Shadows get longer in the evening.
The kid is playing, stepping on his own shadow.
My shadow showed up in the photo.

fix.note: 귀에 거슬리다 = grating to the ear.

ex.s: 옆 사람 전화 소리가 좀 거슬려요.
ex.en: The phone noise from the person next to me bothers me.
That tone of voice kept bugging me.
The shirt tag keeps bothering me.

fix.note: Student of a particular teacher or mentor (스승). A student in general is 학생.

ex.en: The teacher ran into a former student.
I'm Professor Kim's student.
The students gave their teacher flowers.

fix.note: Counter for words: 한마디 = a word, 몇 마디 = a few words.

ex.s: 그 사람은 몇 마디 하고 나갔어요.
ex.en: He said a few words and left.
I can only speak a few words of English.
My finger joints hurt.
That potted plant survived the winter.
It's hard to survive at this company.
I barely survived exam week.

fix.note: Medical: 검사를 받다 = to get tested.

ex.en: I had my eyes checked at the hospital.
The teacher checked our homework.
They check your luggage at the airport.
(To your team leader) Do you have a minute?
I was just promoted to team leader.
Our team leader was late to the meeting.

notes: Fixed unnatural collocations (시험 기간을 살아남다, 목에 거슬리다, 타이어 검사), sunset/shadow logic, duplicate 한마디 example, wrong 제자 note, gendered translation.
